hook: Your short walk here crosses from Africa into the EU.
title: Your Walk Here Enters Europe From Africa
description:
Ceuta and Melilla are Spanish cities on Africa's northern coast, surrounded by Morocco. They are the EU's only land borders with Africa, marked by tall fences. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Geography #PlacesThatShouldntExist
